svg.title: Same stitch count, different modeled widths
svg.desc: Two hundred stitches at five stitches per inch models forty inches. At 6.25 stitches per inch it models thirty-two inches. The width bars share a scale of twenty pixels per inch.

g.text: More stitches per inch → less width when the total count stays fixed.
25% higher stitch density → 20% narrower modeled width
Bars share a scale; they represent widths, not physical swatches or knitted loops.
Row gauge is a separate measurement. This is not a complete pattern resize.
Illustrative arithmetic only. No finished garment or physical fit was tested.
